profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 45 (CyrusOne missing-address campaign): found this combined rows two site codes carry two genuinely distinct confirmed street addresses rather than a shared campus address, and declined to apply either without a way to determine which building the rows coordinates represent.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row combines two site codes, SAT10 and SAT11, into one registry entry. This session found the two carry different confirmed street addresses rather than one shared campus address. A datacenterHawk listing dedicated to SAT10, fetched fresh this session, gives 14785 Omicron Drive, San Antonio, Texas as its street address. A separate datacenterHawk listing dedicated to SAT11, corroborated by a Baxtel listing describing a September 2023 land purchase, gives 15355 Lambda Drive, San Antonio, Texas as its street address, and notes SAT11 remains under construction with no leaseable power commissioned as of the most recent aggregator update. Given these are two genuinely distinct addresses rather than a unified campus address, this session did not apply either individually to this combined row and instead documents both for a future researcher who may be able to determine, via parcel or map geometry, which specific building this rows coordinates represent.

reading.body:
CyrusOne operates two data centers at distinct addresses in the San Antonio area, SAT10 at 14785 Omicron Drive and SAT11 at 15355 Lambda Drive, but has not published power capacity for either facility. SAT11 remains under construction with no commissioned power as of the most recent public record. Without published specifications, the scale of either site cannot be assessed against industry baselines.

Texas hosts 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 operators have published power capacity totaling 468.41 megawatts. This registry cannot rank these two CyrusOne sites by published capacity because capacity is not published. The state context provided ranks this combined entry nineteenth by published megawatts, which indicates the ranking system includes facilities where capacity was published at some point in the past or at the operator level rather than per-site.

No certifications, power source characteristics, or commissioning timeline are published for either SAT10 or SAT11. Whether either site has begun accepting tenant workloads, or what power and cooling infrastructure each building holds, remains unknown from publicly available operator specifications.
